messages:
junie park: Hey y'all! Junie here — started today in Growth. Excited to be part of Redwood. I make small-batch plum jam and I'm learning to ollie (terribly). :wave:

samir goyal: Welcome Junie!! Jam exchange when? :drooling_face: :tada:

lina morales: hi Junie — welcome!! we have a tiny rooftop jam/potluck tradition on Fridays. bring jars if you want :relaxed:

junie park: Ooh yes please. Also quick Q — where do I pick up my badge? first day logistics totally overwhelmed me 😅

hr-bot: HR Onboarding Checklist: badge ready for pickup at front desk (level 1). Parking permit pending. Welcome packet emailed. :white_check_mark:

maya chen: @junie great timing — I'll swing by the front desk in 10 and grab yours if you're still tied up with setup?

junie park: That would be amazing, thanks @maya! I'm at my desk near the big ficus (left of kitchen).

toni: FYI kitchen snack poll: bagels tomorrow or mochi? cast your votes. :bagel: :rice_ball:

morgan: Mochi all the way. Welcome Junie!! also — do you want to be added to the plant swap list? we rescue desk plants every month. :seedling:

junie park: Mochi, jam, and plants? my onboarding checklist is officially a party. Yes to the plant swap!

samir goyal: Quick heads up — if you want a more ergonomic setup there's a keyboard drawer under the spare monitors; ping #devex and they'll sort it.

lina morales: Also wrestling club meets at 5 (kidding). But there is a casual skate run on Thursdays if you want to join Junie's attempts. :skateboard:

junie park: I accept being the official crash-test skateboarder :joy: Thanks for the warm welcome everyone — looking forward to lunch and learning the ropes.

maya chen: Welcome again! If you need any onboarding docs, here's the quicklinks doc I keep: https://redwood.internal/onboarding/quicklinks (DM me if the link errors).

hr-bot: Reminder: submit direct deposit form within 7 days to avoid payroll delay. :money_with_wings:

samir goyal: Jam + mochi + badge = best first day. :thumbsup:
